name: orders
description: One row per customer order including status, amounts, and key timestamps for fulfillment analytics.

name: order_items
description: Line items within an order with product, quantity, unit price, and discount amounts.

name: payments
description: Payment attempts and captures linked to orders, including method, status, and settlement time.

name: customers
description: Customer master records with signup, segment, and lifecycle attributes.

name: subscriptions
description: Recurring subscription plans and billing cycles for members.

name: subscription_events
description: Lifecycle events for subscriptions such as start, pause, resume, and cancellation.

name: products
description: Product catalog with category, brand, and active status.

name: shipments
description: Shipment records with carrier, tracking, and delivery timestamps.

name: web_sessions
description: Anonymous and authenticated web sessions used for acquisition and conversion analysis.

name: returns
description: Product returns and refunds linked to original order items.

name: orders.order_date
description: Calendar date when the customer placed the order (order creation date, not payment or ship date).

name: orders.created_at
description: Timestamp when the order row was inserted into the system.

name: payments.payment_date
description: Date the payment was successfully captured or settled. Differs from order placement date when payment is delayed.

name: payments.authorized_at
description: Timestamp when the payment authorization hold was placed, before capture.

name: shipments.ship_date
description: Date the parcel left the warehouse. Not the order or payment date.

name: shipments.delivered_at
description: Timestamp when the carrier marked the shipment as delivered.

name: orders.gross_merchandise_value
description: Gross merchandise value (GMV) before discounts, returns, and payment fees.

name: orders.net_revenue
description: Net revenue after discounts and returns, before tax. Distinct from gross merchandise value.

name: orders.discount_amount
description: Total promotional discount applied at the order level.

name: orders.tax_amount
description: Sales tax collected on the order.

name: orders.status
description: Order lifecycle status such as pending, paid, shipped, cancelled, or refunded.

name: customers.signup_date
description: Date the customer created an account.

name: customers.segment
description: Marketing segment label such as new, loyal, or at_risk.

name: customers.is_churned
description: Boolean flag indicating the customer is considered churned based on inactivity rules, not subscription cancellation.

name: subscriptions.cancelled_at
description: Timestamp when the customer cancelled their subscription plan.

name: subscriptions.cancel_reason
description: Self-reported or agent-coded reason for subscription cancellation.

name: subscriptions.mrr
description: Monthly recurring revenue attributed to the active subscription.

name: order_items.quantity
description: Units purchased for the line item.

name: order_items.unit_price
description: Unit list price before item-level discounts.

name: products.category
description: Top-level product category used in merchandising reports.

name: returns.refund_amount
description: Cash refunded to the customer for a return.

name: web_sessions.channel
description: Acquisition channel such as paid search, organic, email, or direct.

name: web_sessions.converted
description: Whether the session resulted in a completed order.

name: gross_revenue
description: Sum of order gross merchandise value for completed orders before discounts and returns.

name: net_revenue
description: Sum of order net revenue after discounts and returns. Preferred for finance reporting over gross revenue.

name: gmv
description: Gross merchandise value alias used by marketplace reporting; equivalent to gross revenue before take rate.

name: net_sales
description: Net sales after discounts, returns, and allowances. Closely related to but not identical to net_revenue (excludes some fee adjustments).

name: average_order_value
description: Mean order net revenue per completed order (AOV).

name: median_order_value
description: Median order net revenue per completed order. More robust than AOV for skewed baskets.

name: customer_churn_rate
description: Share of active customers marked churned by inactivity over a period. Not the same as subscription cancellation rate.

name: subscription_cancellation_rate
description: Share of active subscriptions that were cancelled in the period. Distinct from customer inactivity churn.

name: repeat_purchase_rate
description: Share of customers with two or more completed orders in a lookback window.

name: session_conversion_rate
description: Share of web sessions that convert to a completed order.

name: refund_rate
description: Refunded amount as a share of gross revenue over the same period.

name: monthly_recurring_revenue
description: Total monthly recurring revenue from active subscriptions at period end.

name: units_sold
description: Sum of order item quantities for completed orders.

name: on_time_delivery_rate
description: Share of shipments delivered by the promised delivery date.

name: customer_acquisition_cost
description: Marketing spend divided by new customers acquired in the period.

name: customer_lifetime_value
description: Expected net revenue per customer over a fixed lifetime horizon.

name: attachment_rate
description: Share of orders that include an add-on or accessory SKU.

name: inventory_fill_rate
description: Share of ordered units fulfilled from on-hand inventory without backorder.

name: post_purchase_nps
description: Average post-purchase survey score used as an NPS proxy.
